default.text: You're the new Lightborn! Edwin. That's Moss, Fen and Rook. Brightwater Four: rank F, same as you. We signed the same week.

options.text: Four locals at rank F. Why do it?

evening.text: Sit! There's room. Rook, move your feet. You've met the Four? Rank F, same as you.

options.text: Four locals at rank F. Why do it?

name.text: The stream behind the mill. We swore on it when we were nine, with wooden swords. Rook fell in. He says he jumped.

options.text: And why do it at all?

why.text: Because somebody from here should. The Guild sends your kind at everything, and you come back. When the levy took the men, who was left for the goblins? Us.

options.text: Then stay alive. This village needs you more than it needs me.
Start small. Slimes, then goblins. Never the other way round.
Courage is cheap. Show me in a month.

why_kind.text: That's the plan. Fen keeps a list of the ways we could die. It's long. Come and drink with us some evening.

why_plain.text: That's what Rhea said. In more words, and louder.

why_hard.text: A month, then. First round's on you if all four of us are still here.
